items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; all volumes within pipette ranges (p300 for 106/40/250 µL and 30 µL mixes, p20 for ≤19 µL); wells stay under 360 µL; all simulator checks pass.

Fresh tips for each primer, template, fragment and LB addition; shared reagents are dispensed above or into empty wells without re-aspirating; tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks pass.

Quantities match the paper and the reference (13.25/5/0.5/0.25 µL master mix, 2.5 µL primers, 1 µL template, 19/5/1 µL DpnI, 2 µL T4 buffer, 1 µL enzyme, 7 µL water, 10 µL elution, 250 µL LB), and the steps run in the paper's order with accurate comments.
Master mix for 8 reactions, 19 µL per well, plus 2.5 µL each primer and 1 µL template per the FRAGMENTS table gives 25 µL reactions at 0.1 µM primer and 0.5 ng template.

The comment records 98 C 30 s, 34 cycles with gradient annealing, and 72 C 5 min, then 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI are added, then 37 C 30 min and 65 C 20 min, then a pause for column clean-up.
The ASSEMBLIES table gives 3/2/3/2 µL of fragments with 2 µL T4 buffer, 1 µL enzyme mix and 7 µL water, totalling 20 µL in each assembly well.

The comment records a Golden Gate program of 30 x (37 C/16 C), then 60 C, then 4 C; clean-up elutes in 10 µL; 5 µL goes to the TOP10 cells, then 30 min on ice, 42 C for 60 s, 250 µL LB+dextrose, 37 C for 60 min, and plating on kanamycin.

judge.summary: The protocol closely mirrors the paper and reference: the PCR, DpnI, Golden Gate and transformation volumes all match, and the off-deck steps are recorded as comments and pauses. All simulator checks pass, and I found no tip-handling or capacity problems, so every item scores 1.
